findings.finding: Key: From sums: A+a=20, B+b=10 (since S_A=2S_B and S_A=S_B+10). Use a=20−A, b=10−B. Solve A(20−A)=4B(10−B) and A(15−A)=B(15−B) with A≤15, B≤10. Unique integer solution: A=10, B=5. Product=50.

Key: From sums: a+A=2(b+B) and a+A-5=b+B+5 ⇒ b+B=10, a+A=20. So A=20-a, B=10-b. Use products: aA=4bB ⇒ a(20-a)=4b(10-b); a(A-5)=b(B+5) ⇒ a(15-a)=b(15-b). Search a∈[1,20], b∈[1,10] with A≥5. Unique solution: a=10, b=5, A=10, B=5. Product of ages = 10·5=50.
